Problem

The cumulative voluntary-retirement collection in [Native #3470](https://github.com/luizanunciostoca/morro-termux-control/issues/3470) took 79 seconds and failed the unchanged 60-second provider-observation limit while reading 112 preserved WIP blobs sequentially.

## Change

Read independent WIP blobs in ordered batches of at most four. Each batch uses `Promise.allSettled` so started GETs drain before failure is returned. Validate results in inventory order, preserving deterministic precedence of metadata, byte-integrity and transport errors. No subsequent batch or final readback starts after a failed batch.

The two material files preserve complete inventory and tombstones, blob modes/SHA/base64/size/SHA256, durable receipts, owner consent and revocation, before/after refs and main, the 15-second HTTP timeout, and the **60-second total observation limit**.

Concurrency benefits the genuine asynchronous HTTP/fetch path with a process-local token, as used by #3470. The synchronous `gh` fallback remains compatible and serial. No cache, deduplication, retry, clock adjustment or validity extension was added.

## Exact candidate and proof

- Claim admission integrated in [#1338](https://github.com/luizanunciostoca/touristic-digital-platform/pull/1338).
- Current base: `0acd8053209e80a765723130ec11397fcdb6d9f3`.
- Final candidate: `e81350dda6d6dc852cf21431153dcf3f2c1bcd69`.
- Final tree: `a8b4225467d94c56148931c371d29442fccb31b2`.
- Two new deterministic regression tests fail on the serial baseline with `1 !== 4` and pass with the patch. They cover 4/4/1 batching, repeated blob identity at distinct paths, drainage, inventory-order errors and no later reads after failure.
- Full retirement file: **51 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped**.
- Final clean PREPARE/ADMISSION/CERTIFY: **434 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped**. Counts overlap and are not journey coverage.
- Canonical HISTORY generation: **FINAL_PROVEN**, nonce `410190db-7411-455e-8b5b-9265ff4b40c9`; final proof digest `sha256:1bd95ab5c22213c02fde3ea0e52c3c9e8b701d91047360a68e7e23b69ebd0047`.
- HISTORY ran from clean current main with the real authenticated GitHub CLI, in the original executor workspace. Final proof completed before publishing the new ref.
- All four original task/history files remained byte-identical. The generation registry has nine RELEASED leases. Its three metadata changes only reanchor the base, project LOCAL_PROVEN, and append the canonical event; material source bytes remain identical to reviewed commit `2e6f6c953dd4aee6a9f7c7be85aa8e8efc3a1590`.
- Independent final-head review: **PASS, zero findings**. Final provider review at 2026-11-01T01:35:10Z: **Approval recommended**, no open issues and zero review threads.

## Operational limit

The live cumulative collection has not yet been rerun successfully. That requires integrated canonical code, a fresh original-author stop receipt durably backed with the preserved inventory, a new exact-main request, and valid personal consent. This PR does not retire the coverage claim, claim journey/runtime completion, or extend any freshness window.

Final-head remote readback: **17 successful checks, 15 intentionally skipped, no failures or pending checks**. Core Quality and the trusted Merge Gate passed; the gate recorded POLICY_SATISFIED, one active writer, one open PR and no collisions. Candidate frozen for integration; readiness-triggered checks, current-main recapture and expected-head merge remain enforced.

Problem

The cumulative voluntary-retirement collection in [Native #3470](https://github.com/luizanunciostoca/morro-termux-control/issues/3470) took 79 seconds and failed the unchanged 60-second provider-observation limit while reading 112 preserved WIP blobs sequentially.

## Change

Read independent WIP blobs in ordered batches of at most four. Each batch uses `Promise.allSettled` so started GETs drain before failure is returned. Validate results in inventory order, preserving deterministic precedence of metadata, byte-integrity and transport errors. No subsequent batch or final readback starts after a failed batch.

The two material files preserve complete inventory and tombstones, blob modes/SHA/base64/size/SHA256, durable receipts, owner consent and revocation, before/after refs and main, the 15-second HTTP timeout, and the **60-second total observation limit**.

Concurrency benefits the genuine asynchronous HTTP/fetch path with a process-local token, as used by #3470. The synchronous `gh` fallback remains compatible and serial. No cache, deduplication, retry, clock adjustment or validity extension was added.

## Exact candidate and proof

- Claim admission integrated in [#1338](https://github.com/luizanunciostoca/touristic-digital-platform/pull/1338).
- Current base: `0acd8053209e80a765723130ec11397fcdb6d9f3`.
- Final candidate: `e81350dda6d6dc852cf21431153dcf3f2c1bcd69`.
- Final tree: `a8b4225467d94c56148931c371d29442fccb31b2`.
- Two new deterministic regression tests fail on the serial baseline with `1 !== 4` and pass with the patch. They cover 4/4/1 batching, repeated blob identity at distinct paths, drainage, inventory-order errors and no later reads after failure.
- Full retirement file: **51 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped**.
- Final clean PREPARE/ADMISSION/CERTIFY: **434 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped**. Counts overlap and are not journey coverage.
- Canonical HISTORY generation: **FINAL_PROVEN**, nonce `410190db-7411-455e-8b5b-9265ff4b40c9`; final proof digest `sha256:1bd95ab5c22213c02fde3ea0e52c3c9e8b701d91047360a68e7e23b69ebd0047`.
- HISTORY ran from clean current main with the real authenticated GitHub CLI, in the original executor workspace. Final proof completed before publishing the new ref.
- All four original task/history files remained byte-identical. The generation registry has nine RELEASED leases. Its three metadata changes only reanchor the base, project LOCAL_PROVEN, and append the canonical event; material source bytes remain identical to reviewed commit `2e6f6c953dd4aee6a9f7c7be85aa8e8efc3a1590`.
- Independent final-head review: **PASS, zero findings**. Final provider review at 2026-11-01T01:35:10Z: **Approval recommended**, no open issues and zero review threads.

## Operational limit

The live cumulative collection has not yet been rerun successfully. That requires integrated canonical code, a fresh original-author stop receipt durably backed with the preserved inventory, a new exact-main request, and valid personal consent. This PR does not retire the coverage claim, claim journey/runtime completion, or extend any freshness window.

Final-head remote readback: **17 successful checks, 15 intentionally skipped, no failures or pending checks**. Core Quality and the trusted Merge Gate passed; the gate recorded POLICY_SATISFIED, one active writer, one open PR and no collisions. Candidate frozen for integration; readiness-triggered checks, current-main recapture and expected-head merge remain enforced.
